# Debug the anchor case
_tb_str = """\
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 3, in <module>
    print(add(1, "two"))
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "add.py", line 2, in add
    return a + b
           ~~^~~
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'"""

import re
frame_re = re.compile(r'^File "(?P<filepath>.+)", line (?P<lineno>\d+)')
content_lines = _tb_str.lstrip().splitlines()[1:]
print("Content lines:")
for i, l in enumerate(content_lines):
    print(f"  {i}: {repr(l)}")

from boltons.iterutils import partition
matched, unmatched = partition(content_lines, [lambda l: bool(frame_re.match(l.strip()))])
print(f"\nMatched ({len(matched)}): {matched}")
print(f"Unmatched ({len(unmatched)}): {unmatched}")

# Walk through
underline_re = re.compile(r'^\s*\^+\s*$')
ci = 0
num_content = len(content_lines)
frames = []
src_consumed = 0

while ci < num_content:
    line = content_lines[ci]
    stripped = line.strip()
    if frame_re.match(stripped):
        fm = frame_re.match(stripped)
        fd = fm.groupdict()
        fd['source_line'] = ''
        if ci + 1 < num_content:
            nxt = content_lines[ci + 1]
            nxt_stripped = nxt.strip()
            if frame_re.match(nxt_stripped):
                pass
            elif nxt.startswith(' ') and not frame_re.match(nxt_stripped):
                fd['source_line'] = nxt_stripped
                src_consumed += 1
                ci += 1
                if ci + 1 < num_content and underline_re.match(content_lines[ci + 1]):
                    ci += 1
            else:
                pass
        ci += 1
        frames.append(fd)
        print(f"Frame {len(frames)-1} at ci={ci-1}: {fd['filepath']}:{fd['lineno']} src={fd['source_line']!r}")
    else:
        ci += 1

print(f"\nFrames: {len(frames)}, src_consumed: {src_consumed}")
print(f"Remaining unmatched [{src_consumed}:]: {unmatched[src_consumed:]}")

I need to also track which unmatched lines are anchors so they don't end up in the exception message.
